objective: Grow a qualified credit-union audience while preserving editorial trust, usefulness, topic diversity and production quality.

currentDistributionPolicy.frequency: At most one post per weekday and five per week.

decisionThresholds.rule: Use imperfect but directionally useful evidence for reversible experiments. Do not treat pending metrics, inaccessible analytics or one anomalous post as evidence for a structural change. If insufficient sample blocks two consecutive CEO reviews, the second review must take a safe action to improve sample quality or measurement.

activeExperiments.hypothesis: For company-page posts that already qualify independently under the existing High or selective-Library promotion rules, making the reader outcome explicit in the post copy will improve qualified site traffic and engaged sessions versus continuing to optimize only the opening hook.
evidence: The High-only operating-tension experiment produced only one qualifying observation from August 21 through August 27 despite three subsequent publication cycles; the August 24 and August 26 articles were Library and the August 27 article is Standard. The single High observation produced 6 Buffer impressions / 4 reach / 0% engagement -> 1 exact GA4 LinkedIn session / 0 engaged sessions.

The broader seven-day LinkedIn funnel is now 70 Buffer impressions / 51 reach across four metrics-ready posts -> 4 exact GA4 LinkedIn sessions -> 0 engaged sessions. Over 28 days it is 191 impressions / 116 reach -> 13 GA4 sessions -> 2 engaged sessions.

The August 24 selectively promoted Library post reached 43 people on 56 impressions but produced 1 exact GA4 session and 0 engaged sessions. The August 26 Library post produced 4 impressions / 3 reach -> 1 GA4 session / 0 engaged. Reach can therefore rise without producing qualified reading.

Insufficient High-only sample has materially limited the hook decision across consecutive CEO reviews. The replacement improves sample quality without increasing promotion volume: it applies only when a post independently qualifies under existing promotion policy and does not change schedule, eligibility, destination, UTMs or editorial selection.
activeExperiments.boundedChange: For the next 3 independently qualified company-page posts, whether High or selectively approved Library, keep promotion eligibility, fixed schedule, frequency, destination, image rules, editorial gates and immutable UTMs unchanged. In the post copy, state the concrete credit-union operating decision, control or problem first and then state one specific reader outcome from the linked piece (for example the checklist, test, evidence set or decision the reader can use). Do not create extra posts or promote Standard content to fill the cohort.
activeExperiments.primaryMetric: Exact GA4 LinkedIn traffic and quality by utm_content. Target median >=2 sessions per experiment post and at least 2 of 3 posts producing >=1 engaged session. Use Buffer reach as a supporting exposure metric, with a directional target of median reach >=12.
guardrailMetrics: No change to High/Library promotion eligibility
No Standard article promoted solely to fill the experiment
no sensational or overstated promise in social copy
activeExperiments.reviewCondition: Review after 3 independently qualified promoted posts or on 2026-09-10, whichever comes first. Keep only if exact GA4 sessions and engaged-session incidence improve directionally without degrading editorial trust or onsite quality; otherwise revise or stop.
activeExperiments.rollback: Remove the decision-tool promise guidance and return company-page copy to normal editorial discretion. Promotion eligibility, schedules, credentials, destinations and published articles remain unchanged.

activeExperiments.hypothesis: Strengthening internal connections around CUAI pages that already earn Google visibility, while using those proven themes only as a tie-breaker for otherwise-qualified adjacent coverage, will increase qualified organic clicks and sessions without reducing editorial quality or reader engagement.
evidence: Baseline at experiment open: direct Search Console for August 17-23 showed 535 impressions / 7 clicks / 1.31% CTR and the OSFI/RBFCU/Velera treatment cluster produced 5 rolling-seven-day clicks; GA4 Google organic was 6 sessions / 4 engaged / 66.7% engagement.

Current August 20-26 Search Console is 407 impressions / 5 clicks / 1.23% CTR / average position 23.62. The treatment cluster is 3 clicks: OSFI 1 at position 5.7, RBFCU 1 at 17.1 and Velera 1 at 6.9. Rankings remain inside the experiment guardrails even though cluster clicks are below baseline.

Current GA4 Google organic is 4 sessions / 1 engaged / 25% engagement over seven days versus 23 / 13 / 56.5% over 28 days. The quality guardrail is currently below target, but only four current sessions are in the rolling window and the treatment cannot yet be attributed as the cause.

The News hub remains a search-intent opportunity at 68 impressions / 0 clicks / position 17.38 over seven days, but no snippet rewrite is being forced while the core treatment remains early and organic quality is below guardrail.
activeExperiments.boundedChange: For 14 days, strengthen contextual internal links among the existing OSFI agentic-AI controls, RBFCU fraud-investigation and Velera fraud-response pages; use Search Console evidence only as a tie-breaker when multiple new stories independently clear the same sourcing, mission-fit and priority gates; and queue snippet/title improvements only where page-level evidence and editorial clarity support them. Do not manufacture search topics, change the publication schedule, weaken coverage diversity, or rewrite substantive factual claims solely for SEO.
activeExperiments.primaryMetric: Increase combined rolling-7-day Search Console clicks across the OSFI/RBFCU/Velera treatment cluster from the August 17-23 baseline of 5 to at least 8, while increasing sitewide GA4 Google-organic sessions from 6 to at least 8 in a rolling 7-day window by review.
guardrailMetrics: Google-organic engagement rate remains at or above 50%
No sourcing, mission-fit, originality or factual-nuance gate is weakened
No more-material story is displaced solely because another topic has search traction
No material ranking deterioration of more than five positions across two or more treatment pages is accepted without review
No publication cadence or LinkedIn schedule change
activeExperiments.reviewCondition: Review on 2026-09-07 or after 14 complete days of post-change Search Console data, whichever produces the cleaner comparison. Keep if clicks and organic sessions improve directionally with engagement guardrails intact; revise or stop if the cluster does not lift qualified acquisition or if topic selection starts to narrow coverage unnaturally. Escalate to an early revise/stop review if Google-organic engagement remains below 50% after the rolling window reaches at least 6 organic sessions or if two treatment-page rankings breach the five-position guardrail.
activeExperiments.rollback: Remove the search-supported tie-breaker and revert only the added contextual internal links. Existing articles, sourcing, schedules and search reporting remain otherwise unchanged.

priorityTopics: SEARCH-SUPPORTED TIE-BREAKER through 2026-09-07: when multiple stories independently clear the same editorial bar, prefer mission-aligned adjacent coverage that deepens proven organic clusters in AI risk controls, fraud response/investigations and vendor/operational controls. This is a tie-breaker only; never suppress more material coverage or manufacture a search topic.
linkedinHookGuidance: ACTIVE EXPERIMENT linkedin-decision-tool-promise-2026-08-27: for the next 3 independently qualified High or selectively approved Library posts, preserve existing promotion eligibility and fixed schedule; state the operating decision/control first and one specific useful reader outcome from the linked piece. Do not promote Standard content or create extra posts to fill the cohort.
articleOpeningGuidance: EDITORIAL LEARNING from the completed article-decision-first-opening-2026-08-18 cohort: state the operating decision or consequence early when it materially improves clarity, but do not force a fixed 80–120-word template. The formal experiment is closed; normal editorial discretion and all sourcing/factual-nuance gates apply.

guardrails: Never lower sourcing, originality, corrections, SEO, analytics or image quality gates to improve traffic.
Do not optimize solely for impressions, reactions or clicks; include engaged reading, depth, newsletter intent and return behavior.
Preserve editorial diversity and continue covering material developments even when they are not historically high-traffic topics.
Run at most two clearly defined production experiments at once.
Do not change the fixed LinkedIn posting schedule automatically; recommend a schedule change only after the stated sample threshold is met.
Never use personal data, names, email addresses, form values or free-form reader input in analytics or strategy decisions.

decisionLog.decision: End indefinite baseline collection and begin active optimization with one bounded LinkedIn hook experiment.
decisionLog.evidence: Eight Buffer posts are metrics-ready in the 28-day window, recent reach is weak, and waiting for a perfect sample has become an operating blocker. GA4 is instrumented but was unavailable to the manual CEO run because the current ChatGPT connector runtime exposes no Google Analytics reporting action.
decisionLog.uncertainty: Historical UTM attribution is mixed and GA4 could not be retrieved in this run, so the experiment is reversible and site-session conclusions must wait for authoritative GA4 data.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: Three metrics-ready experiment posts with GA4 attribution, or 10 business days if GA4 reporting remains blocked.

decisionLog.decision: Open a second, bounded article-opening experiment because qualified reading depth has underperformed the 28-day pace across consecutive CEO reviews while acquisition remains comparatively stronger.
decisionLog.evidence: Live GA4 shows 47 users, 52 sessions, 57 page views, 11 engaged sessions, 21.2% engagement and 3 built-in 90%-scrolled users in 7 days versus 153 users, 232 sessions, 573 views, 82 engaged sessions, 35.3% engagement and 31 90%-scrolled users in 28 days. The shared-script measurement repair is now live, so the next article cohort can be evaluated on clean post-repair instrumentation.
decisionLog.uncertainty: The rolling 7-day window can move sharply when one high-volume day rolls off, so the experiment is reversible and does not change article selection, schedule or editorial standards.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: Three qualifying post-repair articles or 2026-08-28, whichever comes first.

decisionLog.decision: Stop the completed relevance-led LinkedIn hook treatment and replace it with an operating-tension-first hook for future High-priority posts.
decisionLog.evidence: All three relevance-led observations are metrics-ready and materially below target: each has 4 Buffer impressions; reach is 3, 3 and 4; median Buffer engagement is 0%; and current GA4 attribution is 1, 1 and 0 sessions, with zero engaged sessions. This is enough directional evidence to stop rather than extend the treatment. Problem-led Guardian and RBFCU posts provide a plausible alternative framing signal, but topic/timing confounding means the replacement remains a bounded experiment.
decisionLog.uncertainty: LinkedIn company-page samples remain small and topic effects are substantial. The decision is therefore a reversible framing change only; it does not alter schedule, promotion eligibility, editorial selection, UTMs, images or destination.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: Three qualifying operating-tension High posts or 2026-09-02, whichever comes first.

decisionLog.decision: Continue the decision-first article-opening treatment through its third and final qualifying observation rather than changing the treatment mid-cohort.
decisionLog.evidence: The August 20 article is cohort observation 2 of 3. Live GA4 shows modest depth improvement versus the prior CEO read—25.5% engagement, 12 engaged sessions and 5 90%-scrolled users versus 22.9%, 11 and 4—but all remain below the >=30%, >=18 and >=6 targets. Active users are 39, one below the >=40 guardrail.
decisionLog.uncertainty: The rolling seven-day window remains sensitive to days rolling in and out, and the current cohort is incomplete. No third experiment is opened; the final observation is the smallest reversible way to resolve the treatment.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: The next qualifying News or Insights article, or 2026-08-28 if the cohort does not complete sooner.

decisionLog.decision: Close the three-article decision-first opening experiment with a revise decision: retain early decision/consequence clarity as editorial discretion, but stop the mandatory 80–120-word treatment and do not claim it solved absolute reading-depth volume.
decisionLog.evidence: The August 21 NCUA News article completed cohort observation 3 of 3. Live GA4 now shows a 34.5% seven-day engagement rate, clearing the >=30% rate target and recovering close to the 28-day 36.4% rate. However absolute seven-day depth and traffic remain below the experiment targets and trend pace: 10 engaged sessions versus the >=18 target, 4 built-in 90%-scrolled users versus >=6, and 24 active users versus the >=40 guardrail; the 28-day totals are 82 engaged sessions, 32 90%-scrolled users and 155 active users. The cohort coincided with better engagement rate but materially lower site volume, so the aggregate evidence does not support a causal keep decision for a rigid opening formula.
decisionLog.uncertainty: Rolling seven-day traffic is volatile and the three cohort articles have too little page-level traffic to separate the opening treatment from acquisition and topic effects. The experiment is therefore closed rather than extended indefinitely; the useful editorial principle is retained without a mandatory formula.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: Keep the operating-tension LinkedIn experiment as the only active production experiment. Reconsider a structured article-opening test only when a future cohort can be evaluated with sufficiently attributable page-level traffic rather than site-wide absolute counts.

decisionLog.decision: Open a second bounded growth experiment focused on compounding Google search acquisition rather than leaving Search Console opportunities in a passive queue.
decisionLog.evidence: Current site audience is below the 28-day weekly pace, while Google organic remains the strongest meaningful acquisition channel by engagement quality and Search Console clicks/CTR are improving. OSFI, RBFCU and Velera already have page-one or near-page-one visibility and measurable clicks, providing enough evidence for a low-risk internal-linking and adjacent-coverage treatment.
decisionLog.uncertainty: Search volumes are still small and page rankings can move for reasons unrelated to CUAI changes. The treatment therefore avoids aggressive keyword rewrites, schedule changes or topic forcing and uses a 14-day reversible cohort with engagement and coverage guardrails.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: 2026-09-07 or 14 complete days of post-change Search Console data.

decisionLog.decision: Revise the High-only operating-tension LinkedIn experiment into a decision-tool-promise experiment across the next three independently qualified High or selectively approved Library promotions, without increasing promotion volume or changing eligibility.
decisionLog.evidence: The High-only treatment produced only one qualifying observation through three consecutive later publication cycles, so its sample design itself became the operating blocker. Meanwhile the broader current funnel shows 70 Buffer impressions / 51 reach -> 4 exact GA4 LinkedIn sessions -> 0 engaged sessions, demonstrating that better exposure is not translating into qualified reading. The replacement tests message-to-destination promise using posts that would be promoted anyway.
decisionLog.uncertainty: Post-level samples remain small and topic effects are material. The change therefore does not alter what gets promoted, when it posts, or where it links; it only standardizes the reader-outcome promise for a bounded cohort.
decisionLog.nextCheckpoint: Three independently qualified promoted posts or 2026-09-10, whichever comes first.
